annotation_limitations: Only two public Pi photos, one source board group already inspected during development.
Nominal source px/mm is approximate; lens distortion, perspective, header height and exact board-plane scale are not calibrated.
Does not reproduce D455 optics, focus, noise, exposure, reflection, depth or camera-to-result delay.
Neither an upper nor a lower bound for actual D455 accuracy.
Derived source annotations remain geometric references even when downsampling makes identity visually unresolved; no human readability validation.
No score is used to select a checkpoint, pipeline, threshold or deployment model.
Every target and excluded bbox is scaled by actual output-width/height ratio; original IDs/classes/source ontology preserved.
Evaluator ground_truth_policy is a generic source-ontology template: here coordinates ARE scaled derivatives. No evaluator metric file is rewritten.
Tiny/subpixel labels are retained even if visually unresolved; not human-validated D455 labels.
validation_policy: No validation or selection; reuse frozen main selection verbatim
counts_test_scope: counts.test aggregates general_test and pi_test; native_split_counts reports them separately
